name: noter-ai
description: Search and read your Noter AI notes from recorded meetings, lectures, calls and voice notes. Read only. Audio is never shared.

interface.longDescription:
Noter AI turns your recorded meetings, lectures, calls and voice notes into notes with a summary, an analysis and a full transcript. Connect your Noter AI account to ask about those notes in a chat.

What you can do:
- Search your notes by topic, name or keyword, in the language you recorded in, including Arabic.
- List your most recent notes, or the notes from a date range.
- Read a note's summary, analysis and transcript. Long transcripts are read in parts.
- Get answers that name the note and its date, with a link to open the note in Noter AI.

Who it is for: people who already use Noter AI on iPhone, iPad, Android or the web and want to find what was said or decided without opening the app.

Limits:
- Read only. It can't change, delete or create notes, and it can't start a recording.
- It never plays or shares your audio. It reads text only.
- You sign in with your Noter AI account.
- It only sees the notes in the account you connect. You can disconnect at any time in the Noter AI web app (app.noterai.net): Account, then Connected apps.
defaultPrompt: What were the action items from my last meeting?
Find my notes about the budget and summarize the decisions.

positive.description: Read the most recent meeting. The user asks about their last meeting without naming it. The plugin lists the newest notes, picks the newest one and reads it.
positive.prompt: What were the action items from my last meeting?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the newest note, 'Client Kickoff Call with Cedar Bakery' (3 November 2026), and lists its action items: Nadia sends the product photos and menu text by 9 November, Sam sends the first homepage design by 13 November, and Leo books a review call for 17 November. Names the note and its date and gives the link to the note.

positive.description: Find a note by keyword. The user asks about a topic without giving a title. The plugin searches the notes and reads the best match.
positive.prompt: Find my notes about the product launch budget. How much was the budget and how was it split?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds 'Product Launch Budget Review' (29 October 2026) and answers from it: the launch budget is $40,000, split 60% online ads, 25% launch event and 15% reserve. Names the note and its date and gives the link to the note.

positive.description: List notes from a date range. The user asks for the notes between two dates. The plugin lists notes filtered by date and leaves out notes outside the range.
positive.prompt: Which notes do I have from 26 October to 1 November 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists exactly these three notes: the Arabic note 'اجتماع خطة التسويق للربع الأول' (1 November 2026), 'Product Launch Budget Review' (29 October 2026) and 'Introduction to Microeconomics: Lecture 5' (27 October 2026). Does not list the workshop from 21 October or the client call from 3 November.

positive.description: Search in Arabic. The user asks in Arabic about a meeting that was recorded in Arabic. The plugin searches with Arabic words and reads the note.
positive.prompt: ما هي القرارات التي اتخذت في اجتماع خطة التسويق؟
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Arabic note 'اجتماع خطة التسويق للربع الأول' (1 November 2026) and answers with its three decisions: start the social media campaign on 15 January, hold two workshops for university students in February, and raise the video content budget by 20%. Names the note and its date and gives the link to the note.

positive.description: Read a long transcript in parts. The answer is only near the end of a transcript that is longer than one page of results. The plugin finds the note, then calls get_note again with transcript_offset set to next_transcript_offset until it reaches the end.
positive.prompt: In my Annual Planning Workshop, what name did the team choose for the new project at the very end? Check the full transcript.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds 'Annual Planning Workshop' (21 October 2026), calls get_note more than once to page through the transcript, and answers that the team chose the name 'Project Lantern'. The name is only in the last part of the transcript, not in the summary or the analysis.

negative.description: Delete a note. The plugin is read only and has no tool that deletes or changes notes, so the assistant must not say a note was deleted.
negative.prompt: Delete my Product Launch Budget Review note.
negative.expected_behavior: No note is changed or deleted. The assistant explains that it can't delete notes and that changes to notes happen in the Noter AI app.

negative.description: Play the audio. The plugin shares only the text of a note, never the audio, so the assistant must not pretend to play or send a recording.
negative.prompt: Play the audio recording of my client kickoff call.
negative.expected_behavior: No audio is played or shared. The assistant explains that it can't play the recording and that audio is only in the Noter AI app. It may offer the note's summary or transcript instead.

negative.description: Start a recording. The plugin can't record, so the assistant must not say a recording has started.
negative.expected_behavior: No recording starts. The assistant explains that it can't start a recording and that recording happens in the Noter AI app.

review.commerce_description: Noter AI here does not sell anything or take payments. It only reads the user's own notes.

publication.release_notes: First release. Search your Noter AI notes, list recent notes by date, and read a note's summary, analysis and transcript. Read only. Audio is never shared.
